results.text: Safety of nifedipine in subjects with bronchial asthma and COPD. This prospective study was undertaken to evaluate the safety of nifedipine, a calcium channel blocking agent, on 60 subjects with asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), angina, and normal subjects. All subjects received nifedipine, 20 mg, sublingually. Spirometry was done pre-drug administration and every 20 minutes after for two hours.
